view: PA (frontal), L marker at image upper-right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration and penetration; minimal rotation; right scapula partly overlaps the right upper lung field; mediastinum slightly wide (projection/body habitus)

devices.type: Tunneled dual-lumen central venous catheter (likely hemodialysis catheter), hairpin loop at the right neck/apex
devices.location: Right internal jugular approach, courses down the SVC to the right of the mediastinum; tip projects at the lower SVC / cavoatrial junction, right paramediastinal at the level of the upper right heart border

abnormalities.finding: Hazy airspace opacity in the medial right lower zone with obscuration of the right heart border (silhouette sign), consistent with right middle/lower lobe consolidation (the labelled pneumonia)
Elevated right hemidiaphragm (volume loss vs subpulmonic effusion); right costophrenic angle largely preserved
Borderline to mildly enlarged, globular cardiac silhouette (CTR approximately 0.5)
Mild prominence of perihilar bronchovascular markings (possible mild vascular congestion, low certainty)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA），右側頸部置入隧道式雙腔中心靜脈導管（疑為透析用導管），導管沿上腔靜脈向下走行，尖端約投影於上腔靜脈下段／腔靜脈心房交界處。右下肺野內側可見模糊性浸潤陰影，右心緣輪廓被遮蔽（silhouette sign），並伴右側橫膈上抬，符合右中／下葉肺炎併局部容積減少；右側肋膈角大致清晰。心影呈邊緣性增大，雙側肺門血管紋理略增多；左肺野相對清晰，左側橫膈下可見胃泡。未見胸管或引流管等治療後跡象。
